item.title: So, Which Machine Learning Algorithm Should You Use?
item.description: A practical guide to choosing a machine learning algorithm: understand decision boundaries, group algorithms into families, let exploratory data analysis shortlist them, and match feature engineering to the model you pick.

item.title: Classical or Deep Learning? How I Choose Time-Series Forecasting Models
item.description: A practical decision framework for picking between ARIMA, Prophet, gradient boosting, and Temporal Fusion Transformers — based on what actually wins backtests, not hype.
